zh: 2 的非负整数次幂在二进制里恰好只有一个 1，而 0 不是 2 的任何次幂。
对正整数 v，v-1 会把最低位的 1 变成 0、把它下面的 0 都变成 1；如果 v 只有一个 1，v 与 v-1 按位与的结果就是 0，否则高位的 1 还会留下。
对每个数判断 v>0 且 v&(v-1)==0，成立输出 1，否则输出 0，按输入顺序用空格分隔。
en: A non-negative integer power of 2 has exactly one 1 bit in binary, and 0 is not a power of 2.
For a positive integer v, v-1 turns the lowest 1 bit into 0 and every bit below it into 1. If v has a single 1 bit, v AND (v-1) is 0; otherwise a higher 1 bit survives.
For each number test v>0 and v&(v-1)==0; print 1 if it holds and 0 otherwise, in input order separated by spaces.

explanationEn:
## Approach

A positive integer has exactly one 1 bit if and only if v&(v-1)=0; exclude 0 first.

## Proof of correctness

2^k has exactly one 1 bit in binary; subtracting 1 makes all lower bits 1, so the bitwise AND is 0. If there are at least two 1 bits, subtracting 1 clears only the lowest one, a higher 1 bit remains, and the AND is non-zero. 0 is not a power of 2 and must be excluded separately.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(n) output space.
